strayclient.menu.title: Stray Client
strayclient.menu.cape.tip: Shows your PNG cape. Pick one in the launcher first (Capes tab).
strayclient.menu.mods.empty: No extra mods yet. Add some in the launcher (Mods tab).
strayclient.menu.mods.restart: Mod changes apply after restarting the game.
strayclient.menu.mods.locked: Part of the client, always on.
strayclient.menu.modules.more: Turn on Keystrokes and PvP Plus in the launcher (Modules tab).
strayclient.menu.hud.tip: Drag Keystrokes and the PvP HUD to any place on your screen.
strayclient.hud.title: Drag the modules to where you want them
strayclient.hud.empty: No movable module is on. Turn on Keystrokes or PvP Plus first.
